import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Fix island label variants
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip().replace({'Torgerson': 'Torgersen', 'Bisco': 'Biscoe'})
    # Fix sex case variants
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.strip().str.lower()
    # Convert body_mass_g from text (with commas) to numeric
    s = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(s, errors='coerce')
    # Remove out-of-range body masses
    df.loc[(df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = float('nan')
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    grouped = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    grouped = grouped.dropna()
    return grouped.to_dict()
